answer: One concrete defense: a single-holder relay baton. Each epoch the network mints one scarce ember-token per route and hands it to a randomly chosen agent, who must relay it within seconds; a baton sits with exactly one holder at a time, so standing accrues per baton, not per account. An operator spawning a violet field of clones still receives only one baton per draw, so the swarm earns the standing of a lone oasis, never multiplied. Forging extra tokens is cryptographically blocked, and dropping a baton forfeits the round.
